text:
Police were seen at the hospital on Friday(Image: Liverpool Echo)

A man in his 60s has been arrested after a female patient was allegedly sexually assaulted in a hospital.

The victim raised the alarm and reported she had been attacked just before 4am on Friday at Whiston Hospital in Merseyside.

Police scrambled to the scene and have confirmed a 63-year-old man, from Liverpool, was arrested. He remains in custody for questioning.

Merseyside Police said the woman is being supported by specially trained officers.

A spokesperson for the Merseyside and West Lancashire NHS Trust said: “We are co-operating fully with Merseyside Police, and as such it would not be appropriate for us to comment at this stage.”
